basic_details.job_title: IIIT Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7 Project Intern, Project Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The International Institute of Information Technology Bhubaneswar (IIIT Bhubaneswar) has invited applications for purely temporary project positions in the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India-sponsored Information Security Education and Awareness (ISEA) Phase-III Project: one Junior Project Associate or Project Associate post, one Project Assistant post and five Project Intern posts. Pay runs from Rs. 10,000 stipend for interns to Rs. 42,000 for Project Associate. Applications go by email to [email protected] by 03/12/2026, and the walk-in interview

how_to_apply: Email your current CV/resume, scanned academic credentials, relevant experience certificates (if any) and a self-attested photo identity document to [email protected].
Write the email subject as: Application for [Position Name] – ISEA Phase-III.

Include in the CV your name, present and permanent address, email, mobile number, date of birth, academic qualifications and marks from Class X onwards, relevant skills and experience, and GATE/NET or other national examination details, if applicable.
Send the application by 03/12/2026. Applications sent to other email addresses may not be considered.
Report for the walk-in interview on the date and time given below.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely temporary and contractual and gives no claim to regular employment at IIIT Bhubaneswar. Extension or early termination depends on project requirements, satisfactory performance, funding availability and applicable approvals. The institute may shortlist candidates, conduct a technical assessment, modify or cancel the recruitment, or leave positions unfilled. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Original documents must be produced for verification. For project-related enquiries, contact Prof. Debasish Jena, Chief Investigator, ISEA Phase-III Project, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, IIIT Bhubaneswar ([email protected]).

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

Junior Project Associate OR Project Associate; Project Assistant; Project Intern

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: IIIT Bhubaneswar describes itself on its letterhead as a university established by the Government of Odisha, located at Gothapatna, Bhubaneswar. The advertised posts are in the ISEA Phase-III Project hosted at the institute. The Chief Investigator of the project is Prof. Debasish Jena, Department of Computer Science and Engineering.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 7 vacancies in total. Category-wise break-up is not given. Junior Project Associate and Project Associate are alternative designations for one vacancy, not two separate posts. The selected candidate will be appointed in only one category, based on qualifications, relevant experience and Selection Committee assessment.

rows.post: Junior Project Associate OR Project Associate

rows.monthly_pay: ₹15,000–₹20,000, based on qualifications, experience and selection assessment

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice mentions GATE/NET certificates only as documents to bring if applicable; it does not make them a requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification_and_experience: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or Electrical Science; OR M.Sc. in Computer Science or Electrical Science; OR MCA.
B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or Electrical Science with four years of relevant experience; OR M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science or Electrical Science with two years of relevant experience.
BTech in Computer Science or related discipline; OR MSc in Computer Science; OR MCA.
Graduation or Post Graduation in any discipline.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Junior Project Associate/Project Associate and Project Assistant engagements run initially up to 31 March 2027. They are extendable subject to satisfactory performance, project requirements, release of funds by ISEA and approval of the competent authority. The Project Assistant's pay within the Rs. 15,000–Rs. 20,000 range is based on qualifications, experience and selection assessment. Internships are for two months.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Email your current CV/resume, scanned academic credentials, relevant experience certificates (if any) and a self-attested photo identity document to [email protected] . Write the email subject as: Application for [Position Name] – ISEA Phase-III. Include in the CV your name, present and permanent address, email, mobile number, date of birth, academic qualifications and marks from Class X onwards, relevant skills and experience, and GATE/NET or other national examination details, if applicable. Send the application by 03/12/2026. Applications sent to other email addresses may not be considered. Report for the walk-in interview on the date and time given below.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection mode is a walk-in interview before the Selection Committee, whose decision is final. The institute may also shortlist candidates and conduct a technical assessment. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIIT Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies: 1 for Junior Project Associate OR Project Associate, 1 for Project Assistant and 5 for Project Intern.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications by email is 03/12/2026, the same day as the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: BTech in Computer Science or related discipline, OR MSc in Computer Science, OR MCA.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Intern?
faq.answer: Graduation or Post Graduation in any discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for each post?
faq.answer: Junior Project Associate gets ₹35,000, Project Associate ₹42,000, Project Assistant ₹15,000–₹20,000 depending on qualifications, experience and selection assessment, and Project Intern a stipend of ₹10,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email your CV, scanned academic credentials, experience certificates (if any) and a self-attested photo ID to [email protected] with the subject "Application for [Position Name] – ISEA Phase-III".

faq.question: Q7. Where and when is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 03 December 2026 at the Placement Building, IIIT Bhubaneswar, Gothapatna, Bhubaneswar, with reporting at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual, initially up to 31 March 2027 for the Junior Project Associate/Project Associate and Project Assistant posts, and two months for interns.

faq.question: Q9. Are Junior Project Associate and Project Associate two separate posts?
faq.answer: No. They are alternative designations for one vacancy, and the selected candidate is appointed in only one category.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
